The official FPC documentation can be accessed from here:
https://www.freepascal.org/docs.html
These are obviously reference documentation, not getting started or how-to
tutorials.
The documentation is hosted here:
https://gitlab.com/freepascal.org/fpc/documentation
Issues reporting mistakes/omissions and merge requests with fixes can be
submitted here.

Lazarus documentation is hosted on SourceForge:
https://lazarus-ccr.sourceforge.io/docs/index.html

Tutorials for FPC and Lazarus can be added to the wiki (
https://wiki.freepascal.org/Main_Page).
Perhaps for FPC tutorials take a look at the content of Basic Pascal
Tutorial (https://wiki.freepascal.org/Basic_Pascal_Tutorial)
and add getting started topics there.

Lazarus tutorials are a bit more scattered, but check here to see what is
existing: https://wiki.freepascal.org/Category:Tutorials

Misleading documentation of X/Y parameter of TCanvas.TextRect (#27379) · Issues · FPC / Lazarus / Lazarus · GitLab

Misleading documentation of X/Y parameter of TCanvas.TextRect

 Original Reporter info from Mantis: wp @wpam - **Reporter name:** ## Description: The current documentation of TCanvas.TextRect says: "Writes Text string within a specified rectangle, according to predefined Style". And: "X, Y specify the starting point for writing the &LtPos;var>Text&LtPos;/var> within the rectangle". As I learned when working with another bug report (#0027363) this is not true in general: the x/y coordinates are respected only for top/left-aligned text. For other alignments/layouts the text position is defined only by the rectangle, not by x/y any more. The attached patch clarifies this in the Lazarus documentation of graphics.xml. ## Additional information: I wonder why the "Arguments" section shows up twice in the generated html and chm file. ## Mantis conversion info: - **Mantis ID:** 27379 - **Version:** 1.5 (SVN) - **Fixed in version:** 1.5 (SVN) - **Fixed in revision:** 47566 (#7e93d299dca9bab692bbd8efedd5883dcc3d5290) - **Target version:** 1.4

results.title: Documentation of TOpenOption.ofExtensionDifferent is wrong (#40478) · Issues · FPC / Lazarus / Lazarus · GitLab
results.snippet:
Documentation of TOpenOption.ofExtensionDifferent is wrong (#40478) · Issues · FPC / Lazarus / Lazarus · GitLab

Documentation of TOpenOption.ofExtensionDifferent is wrong

Our docs about `ofExtensionDifferent` wrongfully states: "Allows a file name with an extension which does not match the filters or default extension in a file dialog." This is not how Delphi defines it, and also not how it's implemented in pre-Vista dialogs (using OPENFILE structure, the OS sets the corresponding flag). I've now fixed the behaviour of TOpenDialog in commit 7d4a36a2. The flag will be set by TOpenDialog if `DefaultExt` is not an empty string and the extension of `Filename` differs from `DefaultExt`. Users should not set this flag before `Execute` (since it has no meaning in that context), in fact the flag will be cleared upon `Execute`.
